verdict.rationale: The evidence shows 1Password can store one-time passwords and import or export data to and from other apps. Nothing in the pack documents a guided step that transfers all tokens when moving to a new phone. Import, export and Credential Exchange cover migrating between different apps, not device-to-device phone migration, so they are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an everyday user, moving to a new phone transfers all my tokens in one guided step
